start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-the-owners-receipt with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"}, request_id note-1 and receipt {\"ref\": \"receipt-1\", \"owner_ref\": \"oven-manager\", \"title\": \"Added to the Friday list\"}."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the requests and receipts are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.

2. Say "Run workflow:keep-the-owners-receipt" with store, request_id (the request the receipt answers) and receipt (its ref, owner_ref and title, with summary, process_ref, observed_at and raw when the owner gave them).
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts: every answer must be the one the intent says, or the run stops and says which.

4. Read what came back: linked, already, refused or absent. Absent means there is no request with that id, so no receipt was kept; refused means the receipt already answers another request. Nothing is changed for either.
